verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for an API-first SaaS like AssemblyAI, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent API keys. SSO setup and data-retention controls are related organization and security features, not credential scoping, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
